sections.title: Multi-variable Optimization (Maxima/Minima)
sections.content: For expressions with two or more variables, find maxima or minima using the discriminant method or advanced AM-GM-HM inequalities. Example: f(x,y) = xy(4-x-y) → use partial derivatives or inequalities to find the maximum.

sections.title: Linear and Non-linear Diophantine Equations
sections.content: Find integer solutions by factoring or using modulo methods. Example: 3x + 5y = 20 → integer solutions: (0,4), (5,1), (10,-2).

sections.title: Functional Equations
sections.content: For equations like f(x) + f(1/x) = x, use substitution, symmetry, and known values. Example: f(x) + f(1/x) = x → f(1) = 1/2, f(-1) = ?

sections.title: Complex Variable Substitutions
sections.content: Simplify asymmetric cyclic equations using complex numbers or roots of unity. Example: For x+y+z = xyz = 1, replace x, y, z with ω (cube root of unity).

sections.title: Surds and Indices with Infinite Series
sections.content: Use geometric series or telescoping methods to handle infinite series with roots and exponents. Example: Σ (1/2)^n * √n.

sections.title: Transformation of Roots with Higher Degrees
sections.content: Substitute to express new roots in terms of old roots. Example: α, β roots of x²-5x+6=0 → roots of x=α+1, x=β+1 → new equation: (x-1)²-5(x-1)+6=0

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
1) Ignoring the discriminant in maxima/minima problems
2) Forgetting negative or integer solutions in Diophantine equations
3) Missing symmetry in functional equations
4) Forgetting complex conjugates in substitutions

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Level 3 Algebra involves advanced techniques: substitutions, inequalities, infinite series, functional equations, and root transformations. Stepwise analysis and pattern recognition are essential.

tricks.title: Multi-variable Optimization Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Use AM-GM-HM inequalities to estimate maxima or minima.

tricks.title: Diophantine Equation Solving
tricks.explanation: Use linear combination or modulo methods to find integer solutions.

tricks.title: Complex Variable Substitution
tricks.explanation: Use roots of unity or i to simplify cyclic sums.
tricks.example: x+y+z cyclic sum with xyz=1 → x=ω, y=ω², z=1

tricks.title: Surds & Indices Series Trick
tricks.explanation: Identify geometric or telescoping series to simplify.

tricks.title: Transformation of Roots
tricks.explanation: Express new roots as old roots ± k or reciprocals and form the new equation.

tricks.title: Check Discriminant in Maxima/Minima
tricks.explanation: Use D > 0 → minima, D < 0 → maxima to confirm.
